desc: Build the two NFA/DFA transition tables for s_i=0 and s_i=1, encoding determinized states as (A<<2)|B with one entry per feasible emitted e.
Initialize the DP with state A={0}, B={1} and process each character of s using the corresponding transition lists, accumulating counts modulo 998244353.
After all N characters, sum the DP values for accepting states where A contains 0 or B contains 1, and print the result.
Implement with fast stdin and an O(N) time / O(1) memory unrolled DP.
